commits.subject: coopmwm P3: add learning monitor and budgeted isolated diagnostics
coopmwm P3: retain failed waves and bind accounting and checkpoints

dependency_reason: P3 consumes canonical metrics and injected diagnostic hooks, not learner components. All imported runtime dependencies (protocol, policy_synergy, exact_grade, sumo_verify) already exist in c4/track-base; no accepted component branch is required by this module.

api.monitor_update(cfg, arm, u, receipts): Validate and persist immutable per-arm update u1..u24; receipts is the canonical T2C metrics mapping or {metrics: mapping, sources: JSON provenance}. Exact duplicate delivery is idempotent; gaps/conflicts/edited history refuse.
api.probe(cfg, u): u2/u4: one isolated run on exactly the first three pre-registered states of replicate 0, per configured early_probes arm (default A/B/R). Other updates return not_scheduled with zero work.
api.replicated(cfg, u): u6/u12/u24: exactly five paired TRAIN worlds for B/R, using the same registered state/group/window sets. Other updates including u18 return not_scheduled.
api.read_monitor(root): Read and verify all-arm monitor histories plus scheduled diagnostic summaries; no writes.
api.diagnostic_identity(states): Compatible T2C state_set_sha256/window_set_sha256 over [(snapshot, receipt)] using real snapshot_sha and original windows.
api.isolated_expansion(job, states, current_: Pure expansion using policy_synergy.specs_for: group-new, every solo-new, fresh common-u0 reference, background common-u0, original full windows, captured t0/CRN. Distinct P3 state/replicate/arm/update/branch IDs.

canonical_metrics.missingness: A cooperation metrics are None. Zero SUMO-checked rows require None checked metrics. All-filtered dense targets permit None CE/accuracy. Missing components, nonfinite values and inconsistent shares/counts refuse. No zero imputation.

configuration.learning_monitor: Optional registered settings, defaults match current T2C: history_updates=3, saturation=[0,1], accuracy_tolerance=1e-6, layer_kl_near_zero=1e-8.
configuration.isolated_registration: Required in-memory explicit registration: role=train, metric=policy_cooperation_gain_veh_s, five replicates indexed 0..4, distinct world_seed in existing isolated machinery's TRAIN range 986000..986071, SHA256 state/window identities.
configuration.monitor_dry_run: Default true. Dry calls expand/quote but reserve and dispatch zero jobs. Set false only through the owning qualified runtime.
configuration.monitor_backend.resolve_states(job): Return [(snapshot, receipt)] for the registered world/state/window set; no seed-file discovery.
configuration.monitor_backend.weights(arm, update): Return (current complete policy state dict, common frozen u0 state dict). Common state must match across all cells; current state fixed per arm/update; A probe state must equal common u0.
configuration.monitor_backend.reserve(jobs, phase): Atomically reserve whole wave against coordinator's OWN cumulative ledger and return {reserved: true, phase: phase, sim_s: sum(j.sim_s), job_ids: ordered list(j.id)}; additional provenance fields allowed.
configuration.monitor_backend.run_branch(spec, snapsho: Execute through owning coordinator worker permit, full-layer intervention controller, original window and CRN. Return {status: graded, J_veh_s: finite number, safety: all four nonnegative integer counters}. P3 never constructs a process/runner or reads a checkpoint.
configuration.budget.phases: Required early_probes and isolated_replicated phase caps; full expanded wave must fit. Optional early_probes.sim_s_per_arm / isolated_test.sim_s_per_replicate bound each cell. Global 5M cap, parity960 and smoke accounting remain with G-T2C's existing ledger.
configuration.isolated_test: N=5; bootstrap fixed at 10000 percentile world resamples, level=.95, seed=20261104; per-cell seed=seed*10000+100*update+pair_index.
configuration.criterion_sha256: If provided by coordinator, binds diagnostic receipts to the pre-registered criterion document. Live owner-approval/preflight remains the coordinator's responsibility.

outputs: CLEAN1_STATUS.md (plain all-arm and scheduled diagnostic summary)
track2_diagnostics/branches/<branch-id>.json (durable branch spec and returned result/error, including failures)
diagnose: trigger_saturated at exact active trigger rates 0 or 1
Learning diagnostics return DIAGNOSE, never PAUSE. Explicit safety_stop alone returns PAUSE_SAFETY.

replicated_criterion.metric: delta(all group new, background common u0) - max delta(one member new, background common u0)
replicated_criterion.aggregation: Mean over registered states inside each WORLD, then paired bootstrap over exactly five WORLD replicates; never treat branches or states as independent replicates.
replicated_criterion.common_base: Algebraically zero cooperation gain; fresh all-base reference branch per state supplies matched safety counters. No separate A replicated simulation.
replicated_criterion.primary: u24 pass iff B-common_base two-sided 95% CI low > 0 AND B safety counters do not exceed matched all-base reference (reference multiplied by same branch count).
replicated_criterion.secondary: u6/u12 and B-R are descriptive; final paired episode evaluation remains T1D/G-T2C owned.

tests.scope: Final P3 implementation; CPU tensors, real isolated spec expansion, fake accountant/runner; no physics.
Expanded run before the final two checkpoint-consistency tests; all then-existing 54 P3 cases passed.
tests.failure_reason: Six pre-existing legacy run_update tests call replay_start.owner(), which reads /proc/<pid>/stat. Windows has no /proc. No P3 test failed; shared modules and legacy tests were not modified.

integration_actions: G-T2C imports monitor_update/probe/replicated from tools.coopmwm.track2_monitor and passes the existing canonical metrics mapping after each update.
Inject isolated_registration and the accounting/worker/full-layer-policy monitor_backend hooks into a runtime-local cfg; keep serializable launch config unchanged.
Use P3 scheduled diagnostics as the owning scheduled path so each diagnostic wave is reserved/executed once.
Include the documented status command in G-T2C's RERUN_TRACKS_READY documentation.
open_issues: The six Linux-specific legacy owner tests require a Linux CPU test environment; P3's final 56-test suite passes on Windows.

Qualified cpuV coordinator/backend integration is owned by G-T2C/P1. It must supply the complete layer+trigger diagnostic policy runner and its own accounting/worker hooks. Live smoke was not run in this CPU-only task.
